graph_decision.double_counting_rationale_for_review: Each assessed input is proposed as usage=both (CPT-estimation context + hard observation). Rationale for review: conditioning once in Bayes rule is a single update, not double counting; the LLM conditions table estimates on the patient's context while inference instantiates the same observed states as evidence. Optional missing inputs use estimation context only (the gap is noted in the conditioning context) with no hard evidence, so no update occurs on an unobserved node. The ClinicalStatusGate applicability input is usage=cpt_context only (it gates execution and is never a network node, so no observation exists). Owner to accept or restrict any mapping to observation-only.
graph_decision.excluded_bn07_nodes_with_rationale: ExposureInterpretationConcern, ClozapineTrialAdequate, ResidualSymptomsOnClozapine, ClozapineExposureReview, and PersistentSymptomsReview are excluded from this registration package. They concern concentration interpretation and adequacy/response assessment during ongoing clozapine treatment, which belongs to follow-up review (F5 scope) rather than registration identification plus initiation-discussion readiness. Exclusion keeps R7 and F5 as distinct package identities sharing BN-07 only as a drafting lead; originals are preserved untouched in BNs/BN-07.xml.

graph_decision.why_this_shape: The BN-07 registration-relevant subgraph is retained verbatim for node states and edges: a two-trial adequacy summary, a three-input TRS-review flag, two parallel review flags (adequacy gaps, TRRIP research features), one initiation-preparation flag, and one six-state workflow pathway with urgent assessment first. Ongoing-treatment nodes are excluded per the rationale above. No latent nodes, no posterior chaining into other questions, all discrete nature nodes for the v1 execution profile. Demographics beyond clinical status, PANSS totals, and diagnosis specifics beyond confirmation are explicitly excluded; owner decides additions.

independent_examples_provenance.clinical_vignettes: Eight synthetic author-created cases (1 first-time false gate, 4 established-applicable pathway branches, 1 urgent, 1 unknown trial-constituent gate, 1 permitted-unknown optional set) illustrating gate behavior, missingness, and wording. Proposed template branches and clinical expectations are review candidates, not approvals.
independent_examples_provenance.numerical_fixture: Four hand-worked checks by plain enumeration over network.xml bytes, independent of the implementation under test: (1) single-row lookup under complete evidence; (2) prior-marginal P(AdditionalResearchFeatures=Present)=0.2338; (3) prior-marginal P(TwoAdequateSuboptimalTrials=Yes)=0.10229; (4) transpose/asymmetry detectors on the 4-parent pathway table and the 3-parent two-trial table. Checks verify ordering plumbing, not clinical correctness.

missing_structured_fields_proposed.reason: STATEMENT-07 requires persistence of significant symptoms with domains and validated scale/version; history prior_symptom_response is a coarse enum without the judgment, and a 20 percent improvement rule must not auto-negate it.

Each prior trial needs a clinician adequacy category with agent, dates, response, and adherence evidence; history enums cannot supply the four-state adequacy judgment and medications carry drug identity only.
Second trial assessed independently of the first; same evidence shape as trial 1.
Different-agent check by drug identity; different classes are not required in this draft.
TRRIP 12-week total-duration feature needs a structured duration record; not a computed eligibility gate.
Moderate severity plus moderate functional impairment on validated measures (SOFAS below 60 example) needs a structured record; not a universal gate.
Suspected severe neutropenia, myocarditis/NMS, severe/unresolved constipation, and acute psychiatric danger need a structured current-encounter record feeding the deterministic urgent flag.
Current versus prior versus never clozapine exposure as status only (FR-14 excludes dose/duration/route/frequency); medications list alone does not distinguish current from prior exposure.
Shared decision-making requires a willingness record; willingness is not consent and must be recorded separately. Included only when defined and collected.

A feasible monitoring and follow-up plan per current local guidance (ANC, cardiac, bowel, metabolic surveillance; logistical barriers such as transportation and blood-work access) needs a structured record. Included only when defined and collected.
Benefit-harm, contraindication, and interaction review (with the separate DDI report referenced, never substituted) needs a structured completion record.

owner_questions: Q1: Confirm the trial-adequacy operationalization: clinician-recorded four-state categories with agents, dates, response, and adherence evidence, with the TRRIP reference (at least 6 weeks at therapeutic dosage, at least 80 percent adherence) as background only and no dose/unit/route/frequency/duration numbers stored. Confirm TruncatedByIntolerance precedence and that a 20 percent improvement never auto-negates persistent symptoms.

Q2: Confirm the gate composition (registration AND established clinical status AND confirmed schizophrenia AND persistent significant symptoms AND two adequate suboptimal trials with different drugs) and that a first-time status yields not_applicable with no posterior.

Q3: Confirm the observation windows: current review with explicitly documented historical trial dates; 12-week total-duration and moderate severity/function as optional parallel research features that never gate the review by themselves.
Q4: Approve, amend, or replace the eleven proposed structured fields listed in missing_structured_fields_proposed.

Q5: Confirm the required-versus-optional classification: gate constituents, urgent assessment, and clozapine exposure status block on missing; 12-week duration, severity/function, willingness, monitoring plan, and medical review permit inference with disclosure and are included only when defined and collected.

Q6: Accept or restrict the both-usage (estimation context plus hard observation) rationale, including estimation-context-only handling of optional missing inputs and cpt_context-only handling of the clinical-status gate.

Q7: Confirm the R7/F5 boundary: R7 is the registration established-case package (identification plus initiation-discussion readiness); F5 is the separate follow-up no-improvement package with its own gate, network identity, prompt, and template. Confirm no shared package identity is wanted and that the five excluded ongoing-treatment BN-07 nodes belong to follow-up scope.

Q8: Confirm the six-state pathway vocabulary and the predefined wording, including the no-argmax rule (physician always decides; no branch prescribes, doses, restarts, continues, stops, or clears) and the deterministic urgent flag that never waits for the LLM.

question_enumeration.applicability: Registration encounters with established clinical status whose reviewed gate holds: schizophrenia confirmed AND persistent significant symptoms AND two adequate suboptimal trials with different drugs. First-time status or assessed No on any clinical gate member records not_applicable with reason (no inference, no CPTs, no posterior); unknown gate records needs_clarification and stops later questions.
question_enumeration.intended_setting: General adult clinician-led schizophrenia treatment review as described in STATEMENT-07. Not a prescribing system and not an emergency triage instrument; urgent findings follow local safety protocol and current prescribing information.

output_meanings.AddressDiscussionBarriers: Review prompt: the Statement 7 established-case indication is documented; discuss clozapine and address flagged barriers (willingness, monitoring, medical review) in the same encounter.
output_meanings.DiscussClozapine: Review prompt: the Statement 7 established-case indication is documented; discuss clozapine per local prescribing information. Not a prescription, not consent.
output_meanings.IndividualizedPriorClozapineReview: Review prompt: prior clozapine exposure requires individualized benefit/harm and discontinuation-history review. No authorization of restarting or withholding.
output_meanings.ReviewCurrentClozapine: Review prompt: patient presently receiving clozapine; review current benefit, symptoms, adherence, effects, monitoring. No authorization of continuation, change, or stopping.
output_meanings.ReviewEvidenceAndOtherIndications: Review prompt: the established-case indication is not established on recorded inputs; review evidence completeness and consider other indications. Never a recommendation against clozapine.
output_meanings.UrgentClinicalAssessment: Review prompt: urgent clinical assessment first per local safety protocol; clozapine discussion follows after safety is addressed.

question_enumeration.proposed_time_horizon: Current review using explicitly documented historical trials; no prospective risk horizon is proposed (per BN-07 time_horizon and STATEMENT-07, which gives no forward prediction period). Owner to confirm.
question_enumeration.specific_question: For an adult registration encounter with established clinical status and the reviewed treatment-resistance criteria, given the documented trial history, urgent assessment, clozapine exposure, and parallel review needs, what are the posterior distributions over the Statement 7 clozapine-review prompts, to structure physician discussion and review?

reference_table_provenance.forbidden: No empirical probabilities were manufactured; no guideline evidence rating (1B, B quality) was converted into a probability; no scale total or improvement percentage was converted into a resistance probability.
reference_table_provenance.rule: Roots use fixed illustrative distributions (for example SchizophreniaEstablished [0.65,0.35], Trial1/2 [0.30,0.25,0.30,0.15], ClozapineTreatmentStatus [0.75,0.08,0.17]). TwoAdequate rows: all-adequate-different [0.88,0.12], all else [0.05,0.95]. TRS rows: all-Yes [0.90,0.10], all else [0.04,0.96]. Research rows: both-Yes [0.85,0.15], all else [0.06,0.94]. Adequacy rows: any inadequate/truncated [0.88,0.12], both adequate [0.06,0.94]. Preparation rows: all-Yes [0.12,0.88], all else [0.88,0.12]. Pathway rows: 0.82 on the deterministic argmax state, 0.036 on each of the other five. Every synthetic row preserves its deterministic source argmax without 0/1 hardness. The lookup exists only to give the validator and inference harness complete, normalized, correctly ordered tables. Never present these as patient estimates.
reference_table_provenance.status: synthetic structural placeholder only; zero clinical validity

review_notice: Draft for owner review. The proposed graph, periods, mappings, thresholds-as-background, wording, and reference values are not clinically approved and must not be activated.

source_classification.drafting_lead: BN-07 Statement07_Clozapine_Review_Draft is an incomplete, inference-disabled and deployment-disabled drafting lead (missing priors, deterministic 0/1 workflow tables), not an approved mapping. Registration-relevant states and edges are retained verbatim; ongoing-treatment nodes are excluded as documented; tables are replaced as documented.
source_classification.proposed_for_review: Agent-proposed graph scoping, gate composition, periods, transforms, horizons, wording, required/optional classification, and reference values; not source-derived clinical rules.
source_classification.source_derived: Statements reproduced or conservatively constrained from the cited sources without adding a clinical threshold, a resistance cutoff, or a probability.

source_comparison.assessment_reuse: Diagnosis confirmation reuses diagnosis-v1; PANSS totals and bands are deliberately never converted into persistence or resistance inputs. No C-SSRS meaning is used in this package.
source_comparison.deterministic_tables_resolved: The six BN-07 0/1 workflow tables in scope are documented modeler assumptions, not validated clinical rules. A generator function was verified to reproduce the BN-07 deterministic argmax for every in-scope row (32+8+4+16+8+24 rows); the package replaces them with soft synthetic placeholders preserving each row's argmax (0.88/0.90/0.85/0.88/0.88/0.82 on the deterministic state). Originals are preserved untouched in BNs/BN-07.xml.
source_comparison.f5_boundary: F5 no_improvement_clozapine is a separate follow-up package with its own key, gate (versioned no-improvement rule with baseline encounter/window), network identity, prompt, and template. R7 never encodes longitudinal improvement, percent-change cutoffs, or baseline comparisons; BN-07 is a shared drafting lead only, never a shared package identity.
source_comparison.guideline_gives_no_prescription: STATEMENT-07 states the 1B recommendation and describes TRRIP identification reference points (diagnosis plus persistent significant symptoms; 12-week total duration; moderate severity with moderate functional impairment including SOFAS below 60 as example; 20 percent improvement as additional evidence; two different antipsychotics with at least 6 weeks at therapeutic dosage and at least 80 percent adherence), initiation discussion, monitoring, levels, optimization, and benefit-harm balance. It gives no executable gate, no probability, no prospective horizon, and no prescribing protocol (doses, levels, titration, restart, and taper details are deliberately not encoded here). The draft therefore proposes review prompts plus a deterministic urgent flag from recorded inputs, never a resistance percentage or an automatic prescription.
source_comparison.history_reuse: Trial support reuses the awaiting_review prior_treatment_difficulty_status, prior_symptom_response, and adherence_history candidates plus the drug-only medications list. The FR-14 regimen-detail conflict (BN-07 trial definitions mention dose, scale, blood level, and sampling timing) is resolved by redesign: the package records only the clinician adequacy category with agents, dates, response, and adherence evidence, and never stores or requests dose, unit, route, frequency, duration numbers, or levels (see mapping_gaps.regimen_detail_conflict). Eleven further structured fields are proposed as versioned additions for review.
source_comparison.missing_priors_resolved: All twelve BN-07 in-scope inputs declare parameter_status missing_prior with an explicit no-invented-probabilities policy. The package adds one synthetic reference row per root (documented illustrative distributions) so the artifact is structurally complete; every runtime CPT, including roots, is still estimated per the all-CPT contract with no registered-table fallback.
source_comparison.monitoring_willingness_scoping: WillingToDiscussClozapine, ClozapineMonitoringPlanAvailable, and ClozapineInitiationDiscussionAppropriate are included only as optional inputs with disclosure when missing, per the session contract. A missing optional input never blocks the question.
source_comparison.statute_and_monitoring_deferred: No REMS enrollment gate is encoded (per BN-07 regulatory_update noting the 2025-06-13 REMS removal with continued ANC monitoring per prescribing information); monitoring and side-effect management follow current local prescribing information, not this package.

locators: STATEMENT 7: Clozapine in Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia (1B recommendation)

Identification of Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia (TRRIP reference: diagnosis plus persistent significant symptoms; 12 weeks total; moderate severity with moderate functional impairment e.g. SOFAS below 60; 20 percent improvement as additional evidence; two different antipsychotics, at least 6 weeks at therapeutic dosage, at least 80 percent adherence)
Initiation of Treatment With Clozapine (shared decision-making; willingness and barrier discussion; partial response with persistent symptoms may still warrant a trial)
Monitoring for Side Effects (ANC, cardiac, bowel including severe/unresolved constipation, metabolic effects; REMS context)
Use of Clozapine Levels (adherence, interactions, smoking/caffeine, sampling timing as interpretation context, not encoded thresholds)
Optimizing Treatment With Clozapine (adequate exposure and 8-week reference for ongoing review; augmentation/ECT discussion deferred to follow-up scope)
definition diagnosis-v1, threshold logic (referenced only for schizophrenia confirmation, never as a resistance input)
18 in-scope nature nodes and 6 in-scope DEFINITIONs with GIVEN edges (no metadata-only parents)
6 in-scope nodes with parameter_status deterministic_proposed_rule (0/1 workflow tables)
5 excluded ongoing-treatment nodes (ExposureInterpretationConcern, ClozapineTrialAdequate, ResidualSymptomsOnClozapine, ClozapineExposureReview, PersistentSymptomsReview)
graph_semantics: deterministic review dependencies, not causal treatment effects
regulatory_update: US REMS removed 2025-06-13; ANC monitoring continues per prescribing information
clinical_limit: no fabricated priors or empirical CPTs
Evidence contract and uncertainty (allowlisted projection, both-usage rationale, missingness as versioned content)

unresolved_assumptions: Trial-adequacy categories are clinician judgments with the TRRIP 6-week/therapeutic-dosage/80-percent points as background reference only; no automatic threshold computation is proposed.
A 20 percent symptom improvement never auto-negates persistent significant symptoms (proposal).

Gate composition (registration, established status, confirmed schizophrenia, persistent symptoms, two adequate suboptimal trials with different drugs) is a proposal; a scale total alone never satisfies it.
Twelve-week duration and moderate severity/function are optional parallel research features, never standalone gates (proposal).
Eleven structured fields do not exist and are proposed (see missing_structured_fields_proposed).

Required-versus-optional missingness classification is a proposal (gate constituents, urgent assessment, and clozapine exposure status block; five parallel-review inputs permit inference with disclosure).
Both-usage (context plus observation) rationale needs review; optional missing inputs use estimation context only; clinical status uses context only.
Clozapine exposure is status only; current-versus-prior distinction relies on the proposed exposure-status field plus the medications list.
No prospective horizon is proposed; posteriors are review prompts, never resistance probabilities.
No argmax-to-treatment rule; the physician always decides.
Reference tables are synthetic placeholders with zero clinical validity.
R7/F5 boundary and the five-node exclusion are proposed as distinct package identities.
